title: Reproducible Artifact-to-Deployment Comparison
objective: Map declared Phase 10 artifact runtime-bytecode hashes to Phase 8 block-pinned deployed-code evidence using explicit mappings and deterministic comparison, without inferring identities from names or upgrading results without matching evidence.
excluded_scope: Automatic mapping inferred only from contract names

state_definitions.MATCHED: An explicit mapping links a declared artifact to a declared deployment and their normalized runtime-bytecode hashes are equal.
state_definitions.PARTIAL: A declared deployment or artifact exists, but mapping or hash comparison is incomplete or mismatched.
state_definitions.UNKNOWN: Insufficient declared mapping or evidence exists to evaluate the comparison.
